# The Winter Lab
Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics | College of Public Health | University of Georgia
:::
:::

::: {.content-container}
## A Policy-Driven Approach to Infectious Disease Research

We work directly with policymakers to shape our research questions — so the path from evidence to action is clear from the start. Our work spans three pillars:

::: {layout-ncol=3 .feature-cards}

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-bar-chart-line"></i> Scenario Modelling
Mathematical and mechanistic models to evaluate vaccination strategies, characterize transmission dynamics, and define pathways to elimination for measles, rubella, and other vaccine-preventable infections.

:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> Outbreak Prediction
Machine learning to predict measles outbreak risk at national and sub-national scales, integrating vaccination coverage, surveillance data, and novel data streams. Funded by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

:::

::: {.card}
### <i class="bi bi-droplet"></i> Seroepidemiology
Developing and validating statistical and machine learning methods to leverage serological data across pathogens with complex histories, using simulation frameworks and field data from Zambia.

:::

:::
